# INKWAVE / Tidewater Plaza

Upstream: https://github.com/jaydendavisnc/inkwave
Commit: 3e9b5505ea900cb41851b4d75f16d488552b1794
Copyright (c) 2026 Jayden Davis. See LICENSE (MIT).

Only Tidewater and its shared rendering/building dependencies are included. Stage registries and maps.js are reduced to Tidewater. Wake Up gameplay and navigation live outside this directory. No INKWAVE weapons, multiplayer or ink gameplay are loaded.

Fonts: Titan One and Rubik, SIL Open Font License (see assets/fonts).

Compatibility: inkShading omits the r186-only specularColorBlended field for Wake Up Three r180. No dependency upgrade.
